Market today: Tech is showing mixed signals. Apple is strong, but the broader AI trade faces headwinds from massive funding talks (Nvidia/OpenAI) being seen as a negative, and potential regulatory uncertainty. There's also a rotation of capital into crypto from AI infrastructure.

Your holdings: Your leveraged SOXL is down nearly 50% and needs immediate attention. QQQ, QQQI, and SMH are also showing losses and are at or near their stops. SPAL is a new, highly volatile leveraged ETF with a significant initial loss. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on overall AI sentiment and any further news on Nvidia/OpenAI funding or AI regulation. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) for accelerated decay.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your underperforming and leveraged tech positions amidst conflicting signals in the broader tech and AI sectors.
plays: Adjust SOXL's stop from 200 to a more realistic level to manage its severe -49.65% loss and inherent decay.
Respect QQQ's 670 stop, QQQI's 52 stop, and consider trimming SMH if it breaks its 540 stop.
Consider a new buy on AAPL if it confirms the scanner entry at 335.29-334.95, with a stop at 334.2, given its market leadership.
